name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 5 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the reform of the European Electoral Act – hurdles to ratification and implementation in the Member States
part_text: 5a. Stresses that any measures aimed at increasing the visibility of European political parties or facilitating voting methods must fully respect Member States’ competences over electoral organisation, campaign rules and voting modalities, and must not undermine integrity, security or public trust in national electoral systems;
